'''Farlander's Outfitting and Supply''' was a equipment store in business on a hangar deck level of [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The shop acted as both a showroom for new gear and a pawnshop for second hand items, which they would also buy from customers. The shop stocked a diverse range of equipment including maintenance, survival and shipboard tools as well as some non-military grade weapons such as [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and [[Hunting blaster/Legends|hunting rifles]]. Any equipment not available in the store could often be tracked down and purchased elsewhere on the Wheel by the shops owner, [[Nols]], and his inventory [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[CZ-332]]. Nols avoided purchasing stolen goods to prevent getting into trouble with the [[Wheel Security Force]], whom CZ-332 was always prepared to instantly call through the store security system at signs of theft or other trouble. New goods were sold at the store for around the common market value while second hand items were usually priced at half that.<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Farlander's Outfitting and Supply first appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. The store was included as a location that players could potentially visit with whilst searching for information on the Wheel.
